items.label: ADJUSTABLE BED SUPPORT LEGS
items.value: the height of these bed slats support legs is freely adjustable, so you can adjust it to the right height for use; The normal original height is 8.5 inch (22 cm), maximum total height can be adjusted to 13 inch (33 cm); Please check the size information before you buy to make sure the size is exactly what you need

items.label: BED LEGS ROLE
items.value: some mattresses are so heavy that without proper center support, they may cause the bed slats or metal bed frames to bend or break; This bed center support legs adds the necessary support to your bed slats or bed frame, effectively protecting your bed base/ wooden slats/ platform bed frame from sagging and damage; save you money on bed repair and replacement

items.label: THICK BED LEGS DESIGN
items.value: the our bed support legs have a larger and thicker diameter than most other bed legs, which means that our support legs have a higher load capacity; with a single support leg having a weight capacity of approximately 4400 lbs (2000 kg); And the our bed support legs also comes with fixed rings, using the fixed ring to ensure that the support leg is stable and does not shake

items.label: LOSSLESS INSTALLATION
items.value: this bed support legs has a non lossless installation design that eliminates the need to use screws to punch holes when installing and using it; All you need to do is to adjust the assembled support leg to the right height and put it on the place where it needs to be supported and withstand pressure; convenient and quick, no need for complicated installation process, the specific assembly method of the support leg can refer to the picture

items.label: PACKING LIST

items.label: NOTES
